FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
Edge lines frame the road white-right and yellow-left while lane lines split flows by color [A01].
Why it matters: group lines; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A01
White broken invites shifts, white solid resists them, white doubles forbid them, and yellow broken frees right-side passes [A01].
Why it matters: group lines; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A02
Solid pairs bar everything but lefts and bike passes, solid-right bars your passing, and broken-right frees it [A02].
Why it matters: group yellow-pairs; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A03
Halts land before lines and walks, ONLY arrows compel turns, mixed arrows free them, and centers serve two-way lefts [A03].
Why it matters: group lanes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F04 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A03
Reversible lanes flip by hour, exclusive bike lanes wall out cars, and sharrows share the lane outright [A03].
Why it matters: group special-lanes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F05 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A04
Red, orange, yellow, fluoro, black-white, green, blue, and brown each name one sign family [A04].
Why it matters: group colors; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F07 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A04
Green guides routes and miles, blue-white serves food and fuel, and brown-white marks scenic ground [A04].
Why it matters: group info-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F08 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A05
Stop signs require a complete halt with all-way stops proceeding by arrival order and right-side yield on ties, Yield requires slowing and giving crossing traffic right-of-way without stopping if clear, Do Not Enter bars entry, and Wrong Way orders an immediate turnaround [A05].
Why it matters: group right-of-way-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F09, sec06-F10 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A05
Speed Limit signs post the maximum lawful road speed, Exit Speed signs give the fastest safe speed for an expressway exit ramp, and Speeding Fines Doubled signs warn that speeding fines double in active school and work zones [A05].
Why it matters: group speed-signs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F10 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A06
U, side, red-light, and all-turn bans each name their forbidden move, while one-way and keep-right channel onward [A06].
Why it matters: group turn-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F12 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A06
Pass bans forbid, care plates caution, reserved plates dedicate lanes, and shoulder plates ration stops and bays [A06].
Why it matters: group lane-signs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F13 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A07
Ahead-plates preview signals, stops, and yields, while advisory plates post curve-safe speeds [A07].
Why it matters: group warnings; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F14 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec06-R13 | anchor: A07
Curves all slow without passing, and divided ends land 350 to 500 feet past their plate [A07].
Why it matters: group warnings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F15, sec06-F16 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec06-R14 | anchor: A08
Crossing plates name side roads, bikes, rigs, walkers, and pictured beasts by twilight [A08].
Why it matters: group crossings; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F17 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R15 | anchor: A08
Low Clearance bars vehicles taller than the posted height, Slippery Surface warns to drive slowly in wet weather without sudden acceleration, quick braking, or fast turns, Soft Shoulder warns not to leave the pavement except in an emergency, Narrow Bridge requires staying in your lane, and One Lane Bridge allows one vehicle at a time once clear of oncoming traffic [A08].
Why it matters: group conditions; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F18 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0058]

FACT_ID: sec06-R16 | anchor: A09
Dead signals default to four-way stops unless an officer waves through [A09].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F19 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R17 | anchor: A09
Reds halt with turn exceptions and yields, yellows urge safe stops, and greens go through clear boxes [A09].
Why it matters: group signals; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F20 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec06-R18 | anchor: A10
Red arrows hold with turn exceptions, yellow arrows warn endings, and green arrows free laned turns [A10].
Why it matters: group arrows; difficulty high; prereq sec06-R17; confusables sec06-F21 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec06-R19 | anchor: A10
Flashing yellow arrows yield against green streams, flashing reds stop like signs, and flashing yellows caution [A10].
Why it matters: group flashing; difficulty high; prereq sec06-R17; confusables sec06-F22 [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec06-R20 | anchor: A11
Red X bars lanes, yellow X warns closure, green arrows free lanes, and ramp meters hold for green [A11].
Why it matters: group lane-signals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F23 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec06-R21 | anchor: A12
Orange diamonds, leaning channelers, arrow boards, and vested flaggers each steer work zones [A12].
Why it matters: group work-zones; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F24 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec06-R22 | anchor: A12
Drawbridge reds close spans, yellows warn closure, and greens proceed warily [A12].
Why it matters: group drawbridge; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F25 [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec06-R23 | anchor: A13
Gates forbid all bypass, hands forbid starts with countdowns as clocks, and beacons halt drivers for walkers [A13].
Why it matters: group ped-gates; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F26, sec06-F27 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec06-R24 | anchor: A13
Hybrid beacons step dark-go, flashing-yellow slow, steady-yellow ready, steady-red halt, and flashing-red go-if-clear [A13].
Why it matters: group hybrid; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F28 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec06-R25 | anchor: A14
Rail halts trigger on flashers, gates, flaggers, and visible trains, never parking on steel or inside 15 feet [A14].
Why it matters: group rail; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F29, sec06-F30 [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec06-R26 | anchor: A15
Before crossing railroad tracks, ensure every track is clear with room for your vehicle on the far side, never try to beat a train, and stay ready to stop behind buses or trucks because many must stop at crossings even when gates are up and lights are off [A15].
Why it matters: group rail; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-R25; confusables sec06-F31 [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec06-R27 | anchor: A15
School plates watch children always, slow crossings, honor zone limits and ends, and ready hidden bus stops [A15].
Why it matters: group school; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F32 [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0065]
